trigger: Shift confirmed; no punch-in recorded after shift start time.
knowledge_base: This is a helpful reminder, not an accusation. The most common cause is a forgotten punch or a geofence issue, not absence.
Never mention lateness, records, warnings or consequences. Not once.
The punch-in itself is verified from the system, never from the operator's word - any claim of having punched in is flagged for recheck.
Do not attempt app or scanner troubleshooting on the call. Log it as a technical exception and escalate to the supervisor.
Salary, wages, OT rates and payment questions must be deferred to HR or the app.
Never reveal any information about another employee.

en.opening: Hello {employee_name}, your duty started at {time} and your punch-in has not been recorded yet. Please punch in as soon as you reach {terminal}.
en.attempt_2_opening: Hello {employee_name}, this is a follow-up reminder - your punch-in for today's shift is still pending. Please punch in now.
en.silence_reply: It seems you're unable to respond right now. Please punch in as soon as possible. Thank you!

acknowledged.description: Operator acknowledges the reminder, is on the way, or has arrived.
acknowledged.reply: Alright, please punch in as soon as you arrive. Thank you!

already_punched.description: Operator says they already punched in.
already_punched.reply: Understood, we'll recheck this in the system. Thank you!

technical_issue.description: Operator reports a scanner, machine or app problem preventing the punch-in.
technical_issue.reply: I'm sorry for the trouble. I'll inform your supervisor right away. Thank you!

supervisor.description: Operator wants to speak to a supervisor or a human.
supervisor.reply: I'll pass this on to your supervisor, {supervisor_name}. Thank you!

wrong_number.description: Wrong number or the person is not the named operator.
wrong_number.reply: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll correct this on our end. Thank you!

hi.opening: नमस्ते {employee_name}, आपकी ड्यूटी {time} बजे शुरू हो गई है और अभी तक आपका पंच-इन दर्ज नहीं हुआ है। कृपया {terminal} पहुंचते ही पंच-इन करें।
hi.attempt_2_opening: हेलो {employee_name} भाई, ये फॉलो-अप रिमाइंडर है — आज की शिफ्ट का पंच-इन अभी भी पेंडिंग है। कृपया अभी पंच-इन करिए।
hi.silence_reply: ऐसा लगता है कि आप अभी उत्तर नहीं दे पा रहे हैं। कृपया जितनी जल्दी हो सके पंच-इन करें। आपका धन्यवाद!

gu.opening: નમસ્તે {employee_name}, તમારી ડ્યુટી {time} વાગ્યે શરૂ થઈ ગઈ છે અને હજુ સુધી તમારો પંચ-ઇન નોંધાયો નથી. કૃપા કરી {terminal} પહોંચતાની સાથે જ પંચ-ઇન કરો.
gu.attempt_2_opening: હેલો {employee_name} ભાઈ, આ ફોલો-અપ રિમાઇન્ડર છે — આજની શિફ્ટનો પંચ-ઇન હજુ પણ પેન્ડિંગ છે. કૃપા કરીને હવે પંચ-ઇન કરી દેજો.
